jobs_results.title: Desarrollador/a Python
jobs_results.description:
Somos Plexus Tech. Una compañía tecnológica especializada en servicios y productos IT, fundada en el talento y las capacidades de nuestra gente, más de 2.000 profesionales desarrollando tecnología con alma. ¿Te animas a seguir formándote en tecnologías punteras y vanguardistas en el Mercado?

Desde Plexus seleccionamos Desarrolladores/as Python Mid/Senior para formar parte de nuestro equipo en un proyecto de sector retail, 100% en remoto.

QUÉ NECESITAMOS?
• Experiencia en frameworks como FastAPI para la creación de microservicios.
• Implementación de APIs (síncronas/asíncronas).
• BBDD relacionales y no relacionales (MongoDB, CouchBase, CosmosDB).
• Git.
• Testing.
• Patrones básicos de diseño en aplicaciones de alta disponibilidad y buenas prácticas.
• Enfoque en la entrega de productos de calidad y fácilmente mantenibles.
• Experiencia previa en monitorización de sistemas productivos y uso de herramientas destinadas para este fin.
• Metodologías ágiles.

Es valorable:
• Experiencia... en el uso de librerías matemáticas (numpy, pandas, pyspark, seaborn, sklearn, matplotlib, tensorflow/pytorch/keras, ....)
• Integraciones basadas en metodologías API-First usando estándares de especificación (OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, etc).
• Apache Kafka.
• Arquitectura hexagonal.
• Cloud Azure: Event Hubs, CosmosDB, Librerías Azure Java.
• Experiencia en MLOps

QUÉ TE OFRECEMOS?
• Contratación indefinida + 100% remoto.
• Jornada intensiva todos los viernes del año, julio y agosto.
• Sistema de retribución flexible en seguro de salud, tickets restaurante, guardería y transporte.
• Plan de carrera y formación técnica a medida, para que sigas desarrollándote desde dentro de la compañía.
• Formación de idiomas.
• Club Benefits de Plexus Tech, que da acceso a ofertas exclusivas en viajes, hogar, salud, tecnología, moda y más categorías.
• Formar parte de un equipo dinámico, colaborativo, apasionado por sus clientes y con ganas de dar lo mejor de sí mismo.

Nos apasiona la tecnología, pero sobre todo nos encantan las personas que la hacen posible. Porque con motivación, ilusión y trabajo en equipo estamos haciendo cosas maravillosas

jobs_results.title: Senior Python Developer
jobs_results.description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Python Developer to join our team full-time in Spain.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Python Developer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. You will join a group of backend developers who design, architect, and develop the Center management console, managing the segmentation rules of amazingly large customers, such as financial institutions, insurance, healthcare companies, etc.

Responsibilities:
• Leading new features and problem-solving from requirements to delivery and spanning a vast terrain of technologies
• Writing reliable, efficient, secure, and scalable... code
• Coding in Python and GO as the main languages
• Collaborating with different engineering teams, product teams, and operations
• Communicating with our customers and leaving a continuous impact
• Addressing complex software challenges at the forefront of today's technology
• Being an integral part of our thriving culture and improving the team and the company

Requirements:
• 5 years of experience in object-oriented software development using Python, Java, Go
• Have a B.Sc. Degree in Computer Science or a similar field, or equivalent practical experience as a software engineer
• Experience developing in a microservices architecture
• Experience in working with Linux based system
• Experience in E2E design and implementation of features as part of large-scale backend projects
• Experience working with one or more of the following technologies: Clickhouse, Elasticsearch, MongoDB, Redis, RabbitMQ, Kafka, celery, and other big-data platforms

What's in it for you?
• Care: your mental and physical health is our priority. We ensure comprehensive company-paid medical insurance and 4 additional undocumented sick leave days
• Tailored education path: boost your skills and knowledge with our regular internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy license, language courses and company-paid certifications
• Growth environment: share your experience and level up your expertise with a community of skilled professionals, locally and globally
• Flexibility: Own your schedule – you are the one to decide when to start your working day. Just dont miss your regular team stand-up. We are there to support your work-life balance and provide 23 vacation days & short Fridays
• Opportunities: we value our specialists and always find the best options for them. Our Internal Mobility Program helps change a project if needed to help you grow, excel professionally and fulfill your potential
• Global impact: work on large-scale projects that redefine industries with international and fast-growing clients
• Welcoming environment: feel empowered with a friendly team, open-door policy, informal atmosphere within the company and regular team-building events

About us:

Join a well-established company and a friendly team of professionals.

Our Delivery Center in Malaga is one of the leading IT hubs in Andalusia – it provides an exceptional mix of vibrant tech talent community, wide-open access to expertise advancement opportunities, hybrid/remote work setup & endless Mediterranean seashore summer.

Seize the perks of global opportunities, local atmosphere and industry-leading clients.

Be bold, not bored!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. Can’t wait to see you at Ciklum

jobs_results.description:
Sipay is looking for a Python Developer with experience between 1 and 3 years. Its objective will be to develop new projects in the API in addition to continuing the current projects.

In your day to day work with the most modern technologies ...Python3.6+ (We have projects in version 3.8)OpenAPI3Our APIs are GraphQL and REST, and we are experts in integrating with third party APIs.
We work with microservices philosophy.

We integrate with third-party HTTP APIs, we produce our own APIs and we integrate with non-http protocols, so we will value knowledge both in integrations with APIs and in modeling them.
When deploying, we use Jenkins, Docker and to package you will work with pypoetry.
What do we expect from you?A committed, proactive profile with a strong focus on problem solving.
Open mind and focused on continuous innovation.#J-18808-Ljbffr
